issues.actor: Customer, booking employee, finance risk reviewer, or operations reviewer

inScope: Implement and verify: Customer Trust, Deposit Eligibility and Appeals.

businessRules: The trust subject is the responsible customer account, not the employee who creates the booking; an absent customer account is UNASSESSED and requires full deposit.
Dimensions are Payment 30%, Booking 25%, Property care/cleanliness 30%, and Conduct 15%; identity/history are eligibility gates and confidence, not score points.
Each dimension starts at 50 and is clamped 0-100; tiers are RESTRICTED 0-39, WATCH 40-59, RELIABLE 60-79, TRUSTED 80-100; insufficient evidence displays UNASSESSED.
Default waiver eligibility requires composite at least 80, payment at least 70, cleanliness at least 65, verified email, at least three completed stays spanning 90 days, and no hard blocker.
There is no direct score edit; corrections and reversals append facts and replay the projection under the original or explicitly selected policy version.
Positive, minor, and medium facts decay after 24 months; major/no-show facts after 36 months; active blockers do not decay.
A disputed negative fact blocks automatic waiver while pending but is not a final point deduction.
Policies are effective-dated, simulated, maker-checker published, and historical decisions remain frozen.

Terminal or superseded records are retained; corrections use a new revision or compensating record.

dataPartitions: SYSTEM for internal repair only; otherwise enforce the subject account type and the resource customer, host-party, site, branch, or assigned-employee partition.
fieldGroups: SUMMARY by default; FINANCIAL, PII, DOCUMENT, TRUST_DETAIL, and INTERNAL_AUDIT require explicit grants and response-field filtering.

failureSemantics: Return stable validation, forbidden, not-found, conflict, stale-revision, dependency-unavailable, and rate-limit codes without leaking PII.

Retry only transient operations with bounded exponential backoff; route exhausted asynchronous work to a visible repair queue.
idempotencyConcurrency: Every externally retried mutation requires a scoped idempotency key, canonical request fingerprint, durable result, and mismatch rejection.
Use expected revision or equivalent compare-and-swap; concurrent winners are deterministic and losers receive conflict with current revision.
Consumers deduplicate by event ID and business key and support replay without duplicating money, inventory, notification, or audit effects.
